prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript source file exporting `GlyphSpec`, `GlyphProps`, `ElementNode`, and `createGlyphRenderer(spec)`. The factory returns a function accepting optional glyph props and producing a plain element tree. The root node is a `span`; its class is `glyph` followed by a trimmed nonempty `className`, its width and height default to `1em`, and other supplied attributes are copied onto it. Caller attributes named `class`, `width`, or `height` must be ignored. Its only child is an `svg` node with the supplied `viewBox`, containing one `path` node with the supplied `pathData` as `d`. Omitted props and empty attribute maps are valid. The factory and renderer must not mutate or retain aliases to caller-owned attribute objects, and separate renders must not share mutable child or attribute objects.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
